scope: Seis portadores redesenhados como pipa viva e ajuste adicional do Trancoura. Originais preservados.

creatures.name: Vesperálito
creatures.change: Membranas largas no tórax e pescoço, rosto de poucos planos e suporte lateral integrado de vareta.
creatures.review: Quatro patas com raízes e apoios. Ombros em arco preservados; rosto com olhos violeta, uma rabiola e cristal no eixo anterior corrigido.
creatures.prompt:
Major living-kite identity redesign of the original creature in INPUT1. INPUT1 is the edit target: preserve its individual anatomy, limb count, material palette, eye color, character and the single mounted Crystal Pipa. INPUT2 is author's approved Grifarca redesign, a guide ONLY to Soulmonsters construction and finish: actual face/body anatomy made of tensioned paper volumes, carefully selected broad folds, structural bamboo edging and meaningful knots. DO NOT copy Grifarca's avian head, beak, wings, colors, stance or ancestry. Keep every creature distinct. Direction 45% expressive living creature,45% functional kite construction,10% bold dark selective pixel-contour / clean2D manga.
Body must become a living paper creature, not real flesh/fur/scales under generic armor. Use few strong expressive facial planes, taut membranes for large masses, compressed broad folds at joints, medium-size shaped vanes. Keep sophisticated substantial armor and adult authority, but make plate and body materials integrated. No fullbody origami triangular mesh, realistic muscles or hide, no tiny scales or fur texture, no humanoid costume. Strong silhouette and large-medium-small hierarchy. One continuous rabiola from real body root, no extra souls.
Preserve ONE pale-lilac CRYSTAL PIPA with broad upper kite shoulders, short top and long lower point, small lower stepped notches, mint internal cross-spars and WOVEN KNOT nucleus. Three copper mounting claws hold sides/bottom, top free. Mount must sit on FRONT ANATOMICAL MIDLINE, below neck/head base between limb roots where applicable, never on flank or arbitrary center of page. Crystal axis and breastplate keel align in perspective. Do not make it a different gem or forget nucleus knot.
Clean bold dark ink and flat saturated cel colors,2-3 hard shadow tones, matte shapes; no painterly gradients, photorealism, metallic PBR, noisy texture or 3D. No text or inset panels. Entire fullbody on WHITE LANDSCAPE canvas with breathing space around every tip. Preserve old original separately; this is a new design version.
INDIVIDUAL VESPERALITO: Keep four rooted limbs, extremely high arched shoulder mass, lower small pelvis, small forward mask-beast head, violet eyes and ivory/petrol/copper/plum colors. Redesign cheek/skull as THREE powerful folded-paper planes, short layered jaw, split stepped crest, not a humanoid face or Grifarca bird. Replace many muscle-like organic wrinkles with FOUR broad PLUM folded membrane volumes forming thorax and shoulder flexures. The body itself has a deep convex kite keel, thick paper flank panels pulled between two continuous curved bamboo ribs growing under shoulders toward hips; two mint knots anchor their ends. Do not create open skeletal cage or mechanical circles. Sculptural ivory armor plates and dark petrol recesses remain substantial, their edges now shaped like reinforced folded kite vanes. Near front lowerleg has two wide folded continuous planes, large three-taloned fold-paw; other three limbs identifiable. No fur, scales or realistic musculature. SINGLE Crystal Pipa stays in CORRECTED front chest location beneath neck base between foreleg roots, not the old side position. Keep all four feet grounded, no wings. Rabiola remains attached with one two-colored paper terminal, stronger graphic notch. Clean powerful mature silhouette, a living ceremonial paper beast not an armored normal animal.

creatures.name: Nimbálio
creatures.change: Quilha e ventre de papel inflado, duas velas com recorte gráfico e bordas tensionadas.
creatures.review: Sem patas; duas membranas laterais com raízes próprias. Olhos ciano, rabiola única e cristal frontal alinhado ao rosto e à quilha.

creatures.name: Ofirante
creatures.change: Espiras como volumes tensionados, poucas dobras largas e gola de lâminas de pipa.
creatures.review: Corpo serpentino contínuo sem membros, duas placas cervicais, olhos verdes, mandíbula com duas presas e uma rabiola. Cristal no eixo frontal.

creatures.name: Canticripta
creatures.change: Abdômen liso em grandes segmentos de papel, braços e patas com planos simplificados.
creatures.review: Exatamente quatro patas e dois braços raptoriais, duas antenas e dois painéis dorsais. Olhos compostos magenta. Cristal central no protórax e rabiola única.

creatures.name: Trancoura
creatures.change: Ventre e membros de membranas lisas; grevas dianteiras recuperadas por correção dirigida.
creatures.review: Quatro patas, focinho e olhos azul-gelo, casco-portão e rolo dorsal preservados. Grevas restauradas nos dois membros anteriores; sem cristal adicionado.
creatures.prompt:
Redesign the author's original TRANCOURA in INPUT1 to remove the TWISTED FLESH / MUSCLE SKIN visible below armor. INPUT2 approved Grifarca is a guide only for living-kite material, broad shaped folds and bold clean2D manga. Do NOT copy bird head, wings, crystal, palette or pose. This is Trancoura the adult giant armadillo rolling-shutter/poster creature, not a crystal bearer. DO NOT ADD ANY GEM.
Preserve its cobalt/ivory/raspberry/mint palette, FOUR SHORT STRONG ROOTED LEGS, big three ivory digging claws per forefoot, two separate smaller hindfeet, long tapered armadillo muzzle, two narrow long ears, ICE BLUE eyes, huge articulated domed shutter carapace, rear partial open armor scroll, bamboo support ribs with mint knots, poster patterns with NO text, single complete segmented tail ending in one paper fan rabiola. Strong adult presence.
MANDATORY ANATOMY MATERIAL CHANGE: beneath shell, neck, belly, shoulders, hips and feet are NOT striated purple muscle, tendons, twisted cords, wrinkles or furry hide. They are SMOOTH TAUT MULBERRY LIVING PAPER PANELS with a few very broad deliberate angular plane changes, ONE clean compressive fold at each elbow/hip, an unbroken convex belly membrane with just TWO main shadow planes. Each limb continuous across real joints, no rings or mechanical sockets. Underbelly must be visibly transformed, not covered by additional armor to hide problem. Paws have big planar paper toes with clear claw roots, no sinewy fingers.
Face subtly soulmonsterized: eye planes and tapered upper-jaw form folded paper shapes beneath crown plates, small lower-jaw fold, maintain armadillo snout and eyes not bird or wolf. Remove realistic skin details, keep playful stern adult attitude. Fewer purposeful folds in armor inner poster edges rather than allover crumpled triangle mesh. Shutter shell plates remain rich articulated geometric layer shapes and dark recesses, carapace roll distinct from tail.
45% living creature45% functional kite10% clean manga selective stepped dark contours. Bold confident black line, FLAT bright cel colors2-3 hard-edged tones, no painterly gradients or 3D metal gloss, no twisted musculature anywhere. Fullbody white landscape canvas with safe margins around claws ears scroll and tail, no text. Preserve original separately, this is a sibling v2 design.
creatures.edit_prompt:
Targeted correction to INPUT1 (new smooth-paper-body Trancoura). INPUT2 old Trancoura is ONLY reference for original foreleg armor. KEEP the new smooth MULBERRY PAPER underbody, simple belly and leg planes, all four feet and claws, head, ice blue eyes, rolling carapace and rabiola from INPUT1. DO NOT restore twisted striated muscle or wrinkled skin.
Restore its important articulated FORELEG GREAVES which were accidentally lost: on EACH of the TWO front legs add TWO broad curved overlapping COBALT plates with thick cream poster-paper edges and small raspberry/mint graphic blocks; a fine ivory bamboo side tie and small mint knot anchor each guard, consistent with original armor design in INPUT2. The upper plate covers just below elbow, the lower plate covers upper wrist, leaving a clean smooth mulberry membrane gap and the whole paw/claws visible. Do not armor over fingers. Hindlegs stay as INPUT1 with smooth paper folds and no added bulky armor. Greaves must follow actual leg volume and perspective, not flat floating bands. No new gemstone, wings, limbs or decorations. Preserve all other new design choices and clean flat2D manga shading. One fullbody creature, white background.

creatures.name: Gevoraz
creatures.change: Removidas estrias orgânicas, com grandes lâminas de papel na crista e planos lisos no corpo.
creatures.review: Quatro patas, olhos rosa-gelo, cabeça longa, armadura assimétrica e rabiola única. Cristal permanece no conjunto frontal convergente do peito.

creatures.name: Makaréu
